target.name: Goldman Sachs Middle Market Lending Corp.

announcement.quote: Goldman Sachs BDC, Inc. (“GSBD”) and Goldman Sachs Middle Market Lending Corp. (“MMLC”) announced today that they have entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”).

outcome_evidence.quote: Goldman Sachs BDC, Inc. (“GSBD” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GSBD) announced today that it has completed its previously announced merger with Goldman Sachs Middle Market Lending Corp. (“MMLC”).

deals.notes: GSBD is NYSE-listed per the excerpts; the excerpts never state whether MMLC's shares trade on an exchange (a 425 refers to an 'MMLC Exit Event'), so both_listed is null. Merger agreement was amended and restated on 2020-06-11 (still GSBD acquiring MMLC); stockholders of both approved on 2020-10-02; completion announced 2020-10-12 (filed 2020-10-13).
